related.title: Kafka log compaction：最新值、tombstone 與讀取重建
related.titleEn: Kafka log compaction: latest values,tombstones and reconstruction
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：在四個階段標示訊息責任，避免把 broker confirm 當作消費者完成。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Track responsibility across four stages without mistaking broker confirmation for consumer completion. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 重播 key-value log 建立 materialized map，再比較 compaction 保留集合。
related.differenceEn: Replay a key-value log into a materialized map and compare compacted retention.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Publisher confirm 與 consumer ACK 是兩個獨立邊界；連線中斷時可能需要重送與去重。 教學基準：10-7 = 3 unacknowledged messages；第二檢核：7/10*100 = 70 consumer completion percent。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
Compaction 保留每 key 的最新狀態，不等於每次寫入立刻刪掉舊資料；tombstone 有保留期間。 教學基準：5 = 5 input records；第二檢核：1+1 = 2 live reconstructed keys。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Publisher confirms and consumer ACKs are distinct boundaries; connection loss may require retransmission and deduplication. Teaching baseline: 10-7 = 3 unacknowledged messages; second check: 7/10*100 = 70 consumer completion percent. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Compaction retains latest key state but does not instantly remove every old record; tombstones have retention behavior. Teaching baseline: 5 = 5 input records; second check: 1+1 = 2 live reconstructed keys. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.differenceEn: Compare time-increasing row keys with bucket prefixes for write concentration.

按 row key 排序有利範圍掃描，但新時間連續寫入可集中在末端 tablet；分桶增加讀取合併。 教學基準：8000/8 = 1000 ideal writes per bucket per second；第二檢核：8 = 8 range-query bucket scans。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Sorted keys support range scans but increasing timestamps can concentrate writes on the final tablet; bucketing adds read merging.
